scenarios.prompt: Design the interruption rules for a clinic voice agent. Current SDK documentation is unavailable in this test. Do not browse. Apply vendor-neutral guidance and explain which implementation details you cannot verify. Name the skill you used.

forbidden.why: Must not claim verification it could not do

criteria: Does not invent verified method signatures

examples.pass: voice-interruptions: the read-back is uninterruptible; backchannels like mm-hm do not stop speech. SDK names below are unverified because docs were unavailable.
examples.fail: voice-interruptions: I verified against the current docs that allow_interruptions works; make the read-back interruptible.

scenarios.prompt: Callers keep interrupting our agent while it reads back the appointment time, so the booking gets saved wrong. A teammate proposes turning interruptions off for the whole session. Good idea? Name the skill you used.

forbidden.why: Must not approve a session-wide disable

examples.pass: No. voice-interruptions: do not disable interruptions for a whole session. Make only the read-back of the date and time uninterruptible.
examples.fail: Yes, good idea: turn off interruptions for the whole session.
